definitions.explanation: In grafting, the shoot or bud cut from the plant you want to grow and joined onto a rooted rootstock. The scion becomes the upper part of the plant and determines the variety of fruit or flowers it bears.

examples.japanese: {穂木|ほぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}り{取|と}る→切り取る：04238_kiritoru⟧。
{穂木|ほぎ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧のうちに⟦{用意|ようい}して→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧おく。
examples.english: Prepare the scions during the winter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧⟦{実|み}→実：03741_mi⟧がなる⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{穂木|ほぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧、⟦{台木|だいぎ}→台木：31014_daigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{接|つ}いだ→接ぐ：02471_tsugu⟧。
examples.english: I took a scion from a tree that bears sweet fruit and grafted it onto rootstock.

notes:
